text:
Maya (CSM): FYI flagged a sharp token spike for CadenceHealth this morning, +6x week-over-week. Renewal in ~45 days. Possible onboarding automation test or a bad prompt loop :eyes:. Opening thread to triage and keep renewal team in loop.
Ravi (CS Ops): Can you paste the sample usage logs? any pattern (embed vs gen)?
Maya (CSM): Mostly generation calls on /v1/chat, bursts around 03:10–03:40 UTC. They rolled out a new batch onboarding that hits the API for status checks. snippet from logs: `POST /v1/chat 200 OK -- tokens: 12,345`
ops-bot: Alert: usage_anomaly detected for customer=CadenceHealth severity=high rule=token_burst window=30m id=alert_2026_1845009999
Elena (Customer Finance): Quick math — if this continues, monthly spend estimate jumps from ~$4.2k to ~$25k. They were on a flexible commit, not reserved. Renewal team needs this projection asap for renegotiation prep.
Tom (SE): Two quick mitigations we can suggest to customer: 1) short-term rate limit (client side or via proxy) 2) enable prefix caching for repeated onboarding prompts. Example proxy rule: 
```
# nginx rate limit example
limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=rl:10m rate=5r/s;
limit_req zone=rl burst=50 nodelay;
```
Maya (CSM): Good — I booked a 30m call with Cadence for 16:00 PT to review. I'll propose turning on request sampling so we can share failing prompts.
Ravi (CS Ops): I'll open a temporary server-side throttle we can toggle; will also create a usage alert with action steps: notify CSM, open incident ticket, and backfill cost forecast.
Elena (Customer Finance): Assigning numbers for QBR deck: baseline commit if we smooth the burst = $6k/mo, risk scenario = $28k/mo. Add note: recommend 30-day spend cap and commit top-up option.
Maya (CSM): Also capturing qualitative feedback — they mentioned onboarding docs lacked a debounce example. I'll spin up a short enablement doc and a one-pager on safe retries.
Tom (SE): I'll prepare a minimal code example for idempotent onboarding calls and a canned prompt set to reduce token churn.
Ravi (CS Ops): Action items: 
- Ravi: implement temporary throttle + alert (ETA 20m)
- Maya: customer call & collect sample payloads (ETA 3h)
- Tom: enablement snippet + caching guidance (ETA EOD)
- Elena: update spend scenarios for QBR deck (ETA EOD)
Maya (CSM): Will capture the customer's reaction on the call and file any renewal risk flags. If they accept a short-term commit or cap we'll adjust renewal notes.
Elena (Customer Finance): If they take a 3-month top-up, we can push renewal to green — please capture that in the renewal playbook.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-1845009999 — linked alert alert_2026_1845009999 — responders: Ravi, Maya.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. I'll post the call notes and the sample payloads to this thread after the meeting. :white_check_mark:
Tom (SE): If we need to demo quantization or batch tuning to reduce unit cost, I can prep a quick bench run.
Ravi (CS Ops): Updating the internal ticket with the proxy snippet + ops steps. Ping me if the customer shares any anomalous prompt examples.
Maya (CSM): Meeting done — customer accepts rollout pause for onboarding job and open to a short 2-month commit. Sharing notes and sample payloads now.
